calls_locked.name: calls_locked
calls_locked.value: ("calls"."status" = 'locked') = ("calls"."locked_price" IS NOT NULL AND "calls"."tick_id" IS NOT NULL AND "calls"."locked_at" IS NOT NULL)

calls_via.name: calls_via
calls_via.value: ("calls"."via" IS NULL) = ("calls"."via_user_id" IS NULL) AND ("calls"."via" IS NULL OR "calls"."via" IN ('tail', 'fade'))

items_paid_consistent.name: items_paid_consistent
items_paid_consistent.value: ("items"."source" = 'purchase') = ("items"."price_paid" IS NOT NULL AND "items"."tx_id" IS NOT NULL)

shifts_collected_paid.name: shifts_collected_paid
shifts_collected_paid.value: "shifts"."collected_tx" IS NULL OR "shifts"."pay" IS NOT NULL
